english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for telling two people or things apart.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday way to say that you can tell two things apart.

examples.english: Can you distinguish the taste of these two teas?
examples.traditional: 你分得出呢兩種茶嘅味道嗎？
examples.jyutping: nei5 fan1 dak1 ceot1 ni1 loeng5 zung2 caa4 ge3 mei6 dou6 maa3

examples.english: Can you discriminate between the tastes of these two teas?
examples.traditional: 你分得出呢兩種茶嘅味道嗎？
examples.jyutping: nei5 fan1 dak1 ceot1 ni1 loeng5 zung2 caa4 ge3 mei6 dou6 maa3
